assessments.mechanism: Dendritic target propagation using compartmentalized local mismatch signals in biology-constrained E/I networks.
assessments.clean_scope: Cell Reports 2026 supervised image/spiral tasks. Principal accuracy/alignment plots use five network instances; fixed-random top-down weights remain viable and BTSP-style updates work on MNIST. Author EIANN/Zenodo code exists but no independent replication was found.
assessments.uncertainty: Supervised small/medium benchmark scope, exact supplementary values incomplete, no independent replication.
assessments.o_comparison: No dendritic/local target-propagation learning algorithm or biology-constrained E/I training experiment exists in O.

assessments.mechanism: Sleep-like spontaneous/noise replay with local plasticity to recover old-task structure and reduce interference.
assessments.clean_scope: Nature Communications 2022 plus same-lab 2025-2026 extensions. CUB-200 task1/task2 after sequential training 5%/95% versus SRC 63.2%/45.4%; CIFAR-10 overall 44% SRC vs 19% without; MNIST/Fashion cross-modal 47%→61% versus ~90% joint reference. Frozen/pretrained features and sleep compute are important limits.
assessments.uncertainty: No clean independent replication of exact no-old-data SRC protocol; extensions share lab lineage.
assessments.o_comparison: O execution replay/journaling is not neural sleep/rehearsal learning; no SRC training mechanism exists.

assessments.mechanism: Replay internal/hidden representations through context-modulated feedback instead of reconstructing raw sensory inputs.
assessments.clean_scope: Nature Communications 2020. Class-IL CIFAR-100 BI-R+SI 0.344±0.002 vs 0.334±0.002 without replay-through-feedback; 100-task permuted MNIST 0.904±0.005 vs 0.892±0.004. CIFAR convolutional features were pretrained/frozen.
assessments.uncertainty: Class-IL remains below joint training; no independent replication found.
assessments.o_comparison: No hidden-representation generative rehearsal or BI-R continual-learning experiment was found in O.

assessments.mechanism: Sparse task/context-dependent neural unit gating combined with synaptic stabilization.
assessments.clean_scope: PNAS 2018. 100 sequential permuted-MNIST tasks: first-task 98.2%, mean all 100 with XdG+stabilization 95.4%; 500 tasks 90.7% vs stabilization alone 54.9%. Canonical XdG requires task/context identity.
assessments.uncertainty: Permuted-MNIST separability and explicit context identity limit transfer.
assessments.o_comparison: O semantic context routing is not neural unit gating/synaptic stabilization; no XdG training mechanism exists.

assessments.mechanism: Learn sparse neural context gates from task inputs rather than requiring an explicit task label, while stabilizing old gates and limiting new-task overlap.
assessments.clean_scope: ICLR 2023, 50-task permuted/rotated MNIST. Permuted MNIST final mean LXDG+EWC 96% vs XDG+EWC 97% and EWC 72±1%; three seeds for EWC/LXDG+EWC. Training still uses stored unlabeled old-task inputs.
assessments.uncertainty: MNIST-derived evidence, no independent replication, not old-data-free and still relies on backprop/EWC.
assessments.o_comparison: No learned neural gating network or synaptic continual-learning mechanism matching LXDG exists in O; semantic Skill routing is not equivalent.

assessments.mechanism: Biologically inspired local dendritic forward/backward dynamics as an alternative to backpropagation.
assessments.clean_scope: ICML 2025 MLP/CNN/RNN. CNN average DLL 86.61% vs backprop 90.67%; CIFAR-10 70.89±0.58 vs 75.10±0.54; electricity forecasting MSE/MAE 0.172/0.321 vs 0.175/0.324, while character prediction 33.7% vs backprop 51.9%.
assessments.uncertainty: Algorithmic biological-plausibility study, not continual learning; sequential character task is materially weaker than backprop; no independent replication found.
assessments.o_comparison: No DLL/local dendritic learning algorithm or matched backprop experiment exists in O.
